subject: Request: One-time Hosted API volume concession for Vanguard Health
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@vanguardhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing — follow-up from RFP

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our technical team is excited about the latency profile and the KV-caching approach — it maps nicely to one of our core use cases. Procurement asked me to confirm whether Redwood can provide a one-time promotional rate for the first 12 months. To be specific, they want a 28% unit-rate concession on Hosted API usage for the initial committed volume (6M tokens/month commitment).

I understand this is outside standard published tiers. Can you let me know whether this is something your team can discuss with finance/leadership and what the quickest path to approval would look like? We are targeting a signing timeline by the end of November to hit Q4 integrations.

Attached is the RFP summary and an early SOW draft.

Best,
Elena Morales
Director of Platform Partnerships
Vanguard Health

Attachments: Vanguard_RFP_response_v2.pdf, SOW_vanguard_draft.docx
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@vanguardhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — follow-up from RFP

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and attaching the materials. I appreciate the urgency and the scale of the commitment. I need to run this up internally for exec sign-off since the ask (28%) exceeds our standard playbook. I will come back with an answer by EOD.

Quick clarifiers: is the 6M token/month a guaranteed committed amount for 12 months or a ramp target? Also, is Vanguard requesting spike protection / burst overage caps in the SOW? If you can confirm those two points I will include them in the package to leadership.

– Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vanguard concession request — need exec sanction (28% request)

Team — forwarding Vanguard's request. Summary below:
- Account: Vanguard Health (enterprise, US)
- Ask: 28% discount off Hosted API unit rates for first 12 months on a committed 6M tokens/mo (if guaranteed), signing target before 2026-11-30.
- Motive: strategic partner in payer space; potential reference; multi-product roadmap (embedding + chat).
- Attachments: RFP + draft SOW.

Why this matters: fast closed-won in Q4, high initial committed volume, potential to expand into Dedicated in 2027.

Constraints I foresee: accounting wants clarity on committed vs best-effort; finance needs unit economics for 28% concession across token tiers. Also we should confirm SLA and spike protection language before offering permanent pricing.

Request: Can leadership provide one-time sanction for up to 30% off hosted unit rates for the first 12 months conditioned on: (1) signed MSA + SOW with guaranteed committed volume; (2) DocuSign with prepayment escrow or monthly committed billing; (3) Standard data controls (no PHI).

I've copied relevant ops/finance folks — please reply with a short yes/no + any guardrails by 16:00 PST so I can respond to Vanguard.

-----Original Message-----
${ORIG}
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T12:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vanguard concession request — need exec sanction (28% request)

Ben — I support escalating this. Vanguard is in a sector we prioritize and the reference value is high. From deal desk POV I'd be comfortable recommending a one-time 25% concession with the following musts:
- Fully committed 12-month term (6M tokens/mo guaranteed)
- Upfront first-quarter invoice paid at signing (to mitigate churn risk)
- Explicit spike protection: overage billed at published rates, capped per month at 50% of committed volume unless we agree to a separate addendum

If leadership can approve up to 30% we can meet them halfway at 25% as a negotiated anchor. Laura, can finance run a quick margin sensitivity for 25% vs 28%? Rishi / Karthik, anything on commercial/ops gating I should know?

— Marissa
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vanguard concession request — need exec sanction (28% request)

Short version: finance can greenlight a one-time 28% concession conditional on the following guardrails — I prefer these formalized in the SOW and MSA:
1) 12-month committed volume of 6M tokens/month (non-cancellable)
2) 60-day prepaid partial deposit equal to 2 months of committed spend applied to first two invoices
3) No retrospective application — concession applies only to committed volume; overages billed standard rates
4) Discount flagged in billing system as promotional code to ensure correct amortization for revenue recognition

Rationale: with the deposit and committed term we keep ARR certainty and can absorb the unit concession. Legal should add a clause for termination without refund only for material breach. If leadership is comfortable with these terms, I authorize up to the 28% concession as a finance sanction.

— Laura Bennett
VP, Finance
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@vanguardhealth.com>, procurement@vanguardhealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: One-time promotional Hosted API rate for Vanguard Health (28%)

Hi Elena — good news. Leadership and finance have reviewed and authorized a one-time 28% promotional concession on Hosted API unit rates for the first 12 months, subject to the following agreed conditions:

1) Committed volume: 6,000,000 tokens/month guaranteed for 12 months (non-cancellable).
2) Payment: 60-day prepaid deposit equal to two months of committed spend applied to first two invoices.
3) Overage: any usage beyond committed volume billed at published rates; monthly overage capped at 50% of committed volume unless an addendum is signed.
4) Data controls: no PHI will be processed under this engagement without a separate contractual addendum and SOC 2 + additional attestations.

We will update the SOW and MSA to reflect these guardrails and send a DocuSign package for signature by EOD tomorrow. I’ve copied Marissa and Laura who will run next steps on the SOW and billing setup.

If you are okay with the conditions above I’ll instruct legal to prepare the DocuSign and Marissa will schedule a quick signature walk-through.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Vanguard onboarded.

– Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Vanguard_RFP_response_v2.pdf, SOW_vanguard_draft.docx
